Avenue Flame Discharge.name: Avenue Flame Discharge
Avenue Flame Discharge.description: The user braces and drives a broad, concentrated flame discharge fifty meters along a clear street, dealing massive fire damage to exposed targets until the end of this turn. Held back, the user directs a shorter discharge across empty pavement ahead of opponents, leaving them a retreat. The user must clear civilians and fuel from the line first; dangerous overheating prevents further flame generation for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.
